name: JalRek-Jad
tagline: Heavy health and punishing spell damage.

abilities.name: JAD'S GUARD
abilities.description: A burst of earth magic that damages and slows nearby enemies.

abilities.name: TELEPORT
abilities.description: Jad blinks across the battlefield to escape or to close the gap.

abilities.name: MINER'S ENDURANCE
abilities.description: Jad drinks in the earth, healing himself and raising a rocky shield.

abilities.name: EARTH SPLITTER
abilities.description: The ground erupts under the cursor, hurling boulders at everything nearby.
